defects.title: geometry area metric internally contradictory
defects.detail: A2 geom JSON main_462x401.area_total=366.9630105291308 vs main_546x472.area_total=336.9641621779387 for the same design-15 geometry (8.9% / 30.0 m2 apart); pre01_543x472=337.22384172619815, pre02_483x418=375.59167684315105. A5 independent canonical parse gives f1=f2=369.271374, PRE-01=367.082666, PRE-02=379.082666. Therefore A2 area/Sref (1.013 vs 0.930 unreported) is inconsistent and its 'two families have identical defect metrics' claim contradicts its own area data.
defects.action: recompute with one canonical parser inside A2, include area/Sref per family and cross-check against A1 mesh_identity.parse_vspgeom / canonical_mesh_sha256 (A1 read-only)

defects.title: diagnostic JSON is not strict JSON

defects.title: self-intersection/sliver statistics not self-checked
defects.detail: A2 reports 75 self-int pairs, 82 faces, 28 slivers for the main geometry but no algorithm/tolerance, no canonical cross-check, and reports 6/7 slivers on PRE meshes, so the metric alone does not yet discriminate clean vs dirty.
defects.action: document algorithm/tolerance, report PRE control values, demonstrate discriminative power before preregistering thresholds

defects.title: conclusion strength exceeds evidence
defects.detail: A2 diagnosis md states NaN is design-15 mesh-quality specific and not VSPAERO numerics; the settings part is supported, but geometry-numerics incompatibility (H2) cannot be excluded without a discriminating experiment.
defects.action: restate conclusion as 'settings excluded; geometry-quality risk supported; mechanism unproven'
